item.title: About
item.description:
Hi there fellow web-surfer! I am Rajat K R, an engineering student based in Bangalore, India. I am about 18 years old and on this website you’ll find my writings on things that fascinate me, such as -

  • Books
  • Movies
  • Music
  • Politics
  • History
  • Photography
  • Technology
  • and some other things

I hope you have a great time around here and thanks for stopping by!
